subject: Validation manifest & handoff: Novisys performance onboarding
messages:
From: Logan Hayes <logan.hayes@novisys.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12 09:12 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — throughput/latency targets + onboarding window

Hi Aisha / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Novisys is targeting a mid-October pilot and we need to certify performance before we flip traffic. High level goals:
- Sustained throughput: 500 requests/sec (avg payload ~450 tokens)
- P95 latency: <= 120ms end-to-end (application -> Redwood-hosted model -> response)
- Concurrent users expected in pilot: ~1.2k (spiky distribution)

Can your team run a certification run in our staging environment next week? We can provide sample traffic traces and a staging API key. Also need a short runbook and an artifacts package (raw logs, p95/p99 summaries, and the load script).

CCing our ops alias for scheduling: ops+novisys@novisys.com

Thanks,
Logan Hayes
Head of Platform Integrations
Novisys

Attachments: none
From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12 11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — throughput/latency targets + onboarding window

Hi Logan — appreciate the clear targets. Short reply to confirm scope and propose next steps:

1) Acceptance criteria (proposed):
   - Sustained 10-minute window at 500 req/s with p95 <= 120ms and p99 <= 350ms
   - No more than 2% error rate for the run
   - Token-cost per request within pilot budget (we'll include token accounting)

2) What we need from Novisys:
   - Staging API key (scoped) and sample traffic traces (JSON)
   - Example payloads (auth headers, typical metadata)
   - Preferred run windows (we prefer overnight to avoid production impact)

3) Proposed timeline:
   - Tue 9/14: exchange artifacts + Redwood provides validation-manifest-v1.pdf (test cases, logging, success criteria)
   - Thu 9/16: canary run (20m) -> review
   - Fri 9/17: full certification run (2 x 30m windows) -> results and sign-off

I'll attach the validation-manifest-v1.pdf with the test plan and deliverables. Marcus, Ben — can you confirm available capacity for 9/16–9/17 and whether we should reserve a dedicated pool?

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-09-13 15:20 -0700
Subject: Internal: Novisys validation manifest + test artifacts (prep)

Ben / Marcus — moving to internal thread to coordinate. Key notes from Logan: sustained 500 req/s target, large payloads (~450 tokens avg), spike factor up to 3x for brief periods.

Plan (short):
- Use novisys_loadscript_v2.jmx (JMeter) to emulate their session shapes and token sizes. Script parameterizes token length distributions and key rotation.
- Environment: Redwood Hosted staging region us-west-2 (same as Novisys staging). For reliability, propose reserving a small Dedicated pool for the run window to avoid noisy-neighbor variance — we can release after runs.
- Metrics to collect: per-request latency (client-side and server-side), model KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution, GPU utilization, and full token accounting.

Open items for you to action:
1) Marcus — can you provision a temp Dedicated pool (3 x A100 equivalent) for 9/16 02:00–08:00 UTC? If not, alternate plan is layered staged runs on Hosted with explicit capacity markers.
2) Ben — coordinate with platform ops to ensure we capture server-side traces (trace-id mapping) and that the load agent rotates keys as script expects.

Attaching the load script for your edits. I'll set up a short run owner calendar invite after we confirm capacity.

Thanks,
Aisha

Aisha / Marcus — quick updates:
- Capacity: I can reserve a dedicated pool for the requested window. Proposed pool: 3x A100-equivalent nodes, pinned to the staging account. I'll create the pool and share the pool-id by EOD today.
- Observability: I'll add a tracing hook that stamps each request with run-id (NOV-1084-RUN1) and ensure logs persist to the validation folder for 30 days.

Notes on pass/fail: if p95 breaches 120ms consistently across both 30m windows we mark as fail; if transient spikes are limited to <30s and traceable to upstream retries, we treat as informational and re-run a focused test.

I'll attach the run_schedule_20270915.xlsx with the calendar blocks and owners. Marcus — please confirm the pool-id once provisioned and send me the exact instance tags so I can filter metrics.

Cheers,

Date: 2027-09-16 17:30 -0700
Subject: Certification run results & artifacts — Novisys (canary + first full run)

Hi Logan / Novisys ops — thanks for running the tests with us. Summary from today's canary + first full run:

What we ran:
- Canary: 9/16 02:30–02:50 UTC (20 min) at 200 req/s to validate script + tracing
- Full run: 9/16 03:00–03:30 UTC (30 min) at 500 req/s sustained

High-level results (attached CSV has per-minute breakdown):
- Sustained throughput achieved: mean 504 req/s during the 30m window
- P95 end-to-end latency: 118ms (pass; below 120ms target)
- P99 end-to-end latency: 340ms (within our provisional threshold of 350ms)
- Error rate: 1.1% (largely 429s during a brief 90s backend cache warm-up; see traces)
- GPU utilization averaged 72% across the pool; batch size distribution centered around 8 tokens/request due to payload variance

Artifacts attached and links: latency_readouts_20270916.csv (raw per-request), full trace bundle and dashboards at https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novisys-validation

Observations & recommended remediation before production flip:
1) Brief cache-warmup window caused a 90s spike of 4% errors — mitigation: pre-warm KV cache with a 5m synthetic warmup at start of run.
2) Token-size variance means batching can be optimized; suggest moving to a soft-timeout 60ms batching window for this workload to reduce p99.
3) We recommend an incremental rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over 48 hours with a fallback to smaller model variant if sustained p95 > 140ms.

Next steps: please confirm a sign-off on these results and whether Novisys wants us to schedule the production rollout (we can target Tue 9/21 if you approve).

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
